deploy-bot: Canary id=canary-03 flagged: p95 latency crossed 480ms in eu-central for 5m. Suggested: pause rollout. auto-rollback=OFF (safety_valve=1). link: https://telemetry/c/03
Ravi: saw the alert. pulling kernel logs and frontend traces. ETA 6m.
Zoe: recommend manual hold + pin back to 2.6.1 for hosted. Dedicated unaffected.
OncallBot: Reminder: manual pin requires oncall approval if auto-rollback didn't trigger.
Priya: I'm oncall — approve pin if smoke passes.
Ravi: quick smoke against 2.6.1 looks clean. queue depths normal.
Zoe: pin command (admin): curl -X POST https://console/api/releases/pin -d '{"version":"2.6.1","scope":"hosted","reason":"canary_latency_1768612345"}'
Priya: approved. Priya executed pin and confirmed traffic reverted. AuditID=rbk-zz9.
deploy-bot: Action: rollout paused, hosted pinned to 2.6.1, audit rbk-zz9.
Zoe: filing INFRA-4800 to investigate kernel backpressure + config diff. Owner: Ravi.
Priya: posting short customer note: "Canary rollout paused due to intermittent latency; reverted to stable while we investigate. No data loss." :thumbsup:
